{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)

print("\nValues in customer_segment:")

print(df['revenue'].head())

print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):")
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(df[qa_mask].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:")
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(df[refunded_mask].shape[0])"}
